resolution.question: Does the board of directors of Apex Industries appoint a new CEO during the September 12, 2026 meeting?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the board of directors of Apex Industries formally appoints a new CEO during the meeting, before the meeting adjourns or before 2026-09-12T18:00:00-05:00, whichever comes first. Otherwise resolve NO.
